companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text: SGS is the world’s leading inspection, verification, testing and certification company. SGS is recognized as the global benchmark for quality and integrity. With more than 93,000 employees, SGS operates a network of over 2,400 offices and laboratories around the world.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Location: Kamloops Regional Office, supporting Central BC operations
Schedule: One year contract with possibility of extension, 40 hours per week
Reports to: Team Lead, Environmental Planning

Our client is seeking an experienced Environmental Planner to join its Environmental Planning team in Kamloops for an anticipated contract of approximately 12 months. You will coordinate and implement environmental planning for operational and maintenance (O&M) projects across the Central BC Region.

In this role, you will identify potential environmental impacts and facilitate their avoidance, minimization, and mitigation. You will support environmental permitting, develop environmental protection plans, coordinate monitoring and inspections, and work with project teams, regulators, and stakeholders to help ensure compliance with environmental requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement environmental planning processes for O&M projects, identify potential impacts, develop environmental protection plans, and communicate mitigation measures and procedures.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• B.Sc. in Environmental Sciences or Engineering.
  • Environmental Professional (P.Ag, R.P.Bio) credentials preferred.
  • 6-9 years of relevant experience with pipeline or oilfield application and construction related work.
  • Environmental experience with pipeline operations and maintenance or other oilfield experience.
  • Understanding of environmental regulation (AB, BC) and application of provincial and federal regulations (CER, DFO, ECCC) specifically relating to permit applications.
  • Knowledge of industry best practices for Environmental Protection Plans and associated mitigation measures (e.g. fisheries, soil science, botany, reclamation).
  • Field experience including oversight of contractors.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organization and scheduling skills.
  • Strong attention to detail while working in a time-conscious and effective manner.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with proven ability to work collaboratively with others.
  • Strong organizational and scheduling skills.
  • Attention to detail while working in a time-conscious and effective manner

Field Work and Travel
